trace.command: cd /; npm install -g /mnt/session/uploads/noacg-cli.tgz 2>&1 | tail -2; noacg --version; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done); noacg doctor 2>&1 | tail -15
export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; mkdir -p /workspace; cd /workspace; noacg scaffold --type scoreboard --design neutral --out /workspace/graphic 2>&1 | tail -20; ls -R /workspace/graphic

cd /workspace && export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; mkdir -p /workspace/s2; for t in 0.05 0.15 0.3; do noacg screenshot /workspace/graphic --event goalA --at $t --background video --out /workspace/s2/ga-$t.png >/dev/null 2>&1; noacg screenshot /workspace/graphic --event final --at $t --background video --out /workspace/s2/fi-$t.png >/dev/null 2>&1; done; ls /workspace/s2; noacg screenshot --help 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace && export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg screenshot --help 2>&1 | grep -i -A3 "\-\-at"; for t in 2 1500ms; do noacg screenshot /workspace/graphic --event goalA --event final --at $t --background video --out /workspace/s2/x-$t.png 2>&1 | tail -2; done

cd /workspace/s2 && rm -f *.png sheet.jpg; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; for t in 60ms 200ms 1500ms; do noacg screenshot /workspace/graphic --event goalA --at $t --background video --out ga-$t.png >/dev/null 2>&1; noacg screenshot /workspace/graphic --event goalA --event goalB --event final --at $t --background video --out fi-$t.png >/dev/null 2>&1; done; montage ga-60ms.png ga-200ms.png ga-1500ms.png fi-60ms.png fi-200ms.png fi-1500ms.png -crop 700x300+0+0 +repage -geometry +4+4 -tile 3x sheet.jpg

cd /workspace && export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg record /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json 2>&1 | tail -1; noacg screenshot /workspace/graphic --event goalA --event goalA --event goalB --event final --at 1500ms --background video --out /workspace/s2/lose.png | tail -1; convert /workspace/s2/lose.png -crop 700x300+0+0 /workspace/s2/lose-c.png; rm -rf /mnt/session/outputs/coverage; noacg coverage /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/coverage 2>&1 | tail -3; noacg inspect /workspace/graphic 2>&1 | head -40
